items.title: Burrill Crohn interviewed by Monk Rowe, Woodstock, New York, January 3, 2012
items.q: there was Gjon Mili films about shooting Lester Young and the dancers and, what’s it called?

ctx.x: “L’Atalante” — The Atlantic. It’s about a tug boat. “The Conversation.” I just saw a wonderful film called “Nostalgia for the Light,” a film made in Chile, it was a documentary, “Last of the Blue Devils.” I’ve got to talk about Bruce Ricker because he was the Godfather. He made “Last of the Blue Devils,” and he was a lawyer in Kansas City. And he just was listening to this jazz that he loved and somehow he found some money and got some cameras and he just shot all this stuff and edited the film. Who knew that you…
Oh yeah. He’s playing and the smoke.
